qc.label_under_test: A bare word-onset token (' p' or Korean ' 프') that starts a word the tokenizer splits, ahead of the rest of the word

neighbours.label: A word-initial piece ending in the letter p (' p', ' ap', ' rep', ' imp', ' cop', ' sup'; Korean ' 프') with the rest of the word still to come, mostly in Spanish, French or Korean text; not whole-token words like 'pan' and not mid-word pieces
